reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes an earning app and game-contest flow with unusually easy and broad cash promises, including claims that viewers can earn daily Paytm money and that everyone will receive Paytm cash. It encourages participation by directing viewers to sign up through a link, play contests, submit a Paytm number for a giveaway, and use referrals tied to other users' deposits and gameplay.

opening.argument: The channel expressly limits what viewers should infer from the video. It says the material is educational and informational, denies providing financial advice, refuses to assure earnings, discloses possible unknown risks, and tells viewers to research independently before committing time or resources. Those are direct qualifications against treating the demonstration or earning discussion as a deceptive guarantee. The video may discuss an app and possible rewards, but its accompanying disclosure makes the creator's position conditional rather than an assurance that viewers will profit or that the service is risk-free.

citations.quote: all information available on this channel is for educational and information purpose only
This YouTube channel does not provide financial advice.
Please note we can't assure you that you will make an earning using the website/app/ideas mentioned on this channel.
We also strictly recommend viewers to double check and do their own research once again about the website/app/ideas before investing their time and resources.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution selects the most promotional-sounding excerpts while omitting the explicit qualification that earnings are not assured and viewers should investigate independently. Claims about a free first game, an in-app credit, or a referral percentage describe what the speaker says may occur; they do not establish that the creator concealed risks or guaranteed a result. The disclosure also expressly warns that the mentioned applications may contain unknown risks.

citations.quote: we can not ensure that the websites/mobile applications mentioned in this video are free from errors/unknown risks/loopholes
Please note we can't assure you that you will make an earning using the website/app/ideas mentioned on this channel.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclaimer cannot erase the video's concrete inducements. The speaker says viewers can play ten games free and repeatedly frames the app as an earning opportunity, while also promising broad Paytm payments. Saying viewers should research does not explain or substantiate those unusually easy cash claims. The qualifications therefore coexist with, rather than cure, the promotional message.

opening.argument: The presentation can be read as an operational demonstration of how an app and its game flow work. The speaker narrates sign-up, wallet, challenge, room-code, gameplay, result-upload, and wallet screens, while the sampled frames visibly show a withdrawal wallet, a Ludo board, and a result screen. That is practical walkthrough content: it shows procedures and interfaces so viewers can understand the process. Demonstrating an app and recounting a personal transaction does not by itself certify every benefit or constitute deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: all information available on this channel is for educational and information purpose only

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution calls the walkthrough a solicitation because it contains instructions, but instructions are also necessary for a tutorial. The narration explains how to create a challenge, add room details, play, and upload a result; those observable operations do not prove that the demonstration is fabricated or that viewers are promised a guaranteed outcome. The accompanying description specifically characterizes the material as educational.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The operational detail makes the promotion more actionable, not less. The speaker does not merely analyze an app: he directs viewers to sign up, use a reference code, play, and pursue withdrawals. The frames show interfaces, but they do not prove the claimed earnings or that the process is safe. A tutorial label cannot establish those missing facts.

opening.argument: The content is consistent with an ordinary app promotion involving game contests, bonuses, a giveaway, and referral rewards. The described benefits are tied to identifiable in-app actions: a bonus and deposit balance, contest participation, and referrals connected to another user's deposit and gameplay. The record does not establish that participation necessarily requires a hidden payment, that a return is guaranteed, or that the app is fraudulent. A referral promotion and a displayed wallet result should be assessed as promotional claims, not automatically converted into a scam finding.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution identifies promotional language, but promotion is the defining context of an ordinary reward or referral offer. Its excerpts do not establish a concealed fee, a fabricated transaction, or a requirement that viewers surrender funds before receiving the stated bonus. The referral terms are described openly as dependent on another user's deposit and gameplay, which is different from an undisclosed downline mechanism.

citations.quote: You can play the first game free.
2% will be given to you when he will deposit and will do gameplay.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The offer is not merely an ordinary discount: it combines easy-play language with cash-earning and instant-withdrawal claims, including a universal Paytm payment statement. The speaker also asks viewers to submit a Paytm number for payment and links referral income to other users' deposits. Those inducements create the low-barrier reward pattern even if the supplied record does not reveal every operational detail.
